FORM.TITLE: Send a bulk message
FORM.DESCRIPTION: Send a message to multiple contacts at once by entering their phone numbers below. Each contact will receive the message in their existing conversation, or a new one will be created for them.

PHONE_NUMBERS.LABEL: Phone numbers
PHONE_NUMBERS.PLACEHOLDER: Enter or paste phone numbers, separated by commas or new lines
PHONE_NUMBERS.ERROR: At least one phone number is required

API.ERROR_MESSAGE: Could not send the bulk message
